# LaborCraft 0.2.0-alpha.2

Player-selected themes and worker speech bubbles moved into Quill UI Extras.

## Added

- **Six themes** selectable in the Profile screen: Labor, Glass, Flat, Light, Forest and Amethyst.
  The choice is client-side and stored in `config/laborcraft-ui.json`.
- **Glass** uses translucent panels with cool highlights; **Light** keeps a transparent screen
  background with a translucent panel, so the world stays visible around the window.
- Worker speech bubbles now use the generic `QuillBubbleHud` from **Quill UI Extras**.

## Changed

- HUDs and the item grid follow the selected theme.
- UI colours are declared with `QuillColors`, without hexadecimal literals.

## Fixed

- Primary and danger buttons had low-contrast text in Glass, Forest and Amethyst.
- The speech bubble uses a soft 2 px theme shadow instead of a hard plate, and text without a hard
  shadow.

## Notes

- Client-side, install **Quill UI 0.3.0-alpha.5** and **Quill UI Extras 0.3.0-alpha.5** next to
  LaborCraft. Dedicated servers need neither jar.
- Alpha release: the UI and API may still change before 1.0.

## Links

- Source: https://github.com/NetoTTT/laborcraft
- Issues: https://github.com/NetoTTT/laborcraft/issues
- Changelog: https://github.com/NetoTTT/laborcraft/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md
- Quill UI: https://github.com/NetoTTT/quill-ui

## Target

Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ / Fabric API 0.164.0+26.3. Java 25.

# LaborCraft 0.2.0-alpha.1

The first release with the entire interface rebuilt on **Quill UI 0.3**. The last three screens on
absolute layouts (workstation, worker backpack and admin panel) were rewritten from scratch, and the
legacy visual code was removed.

## Added

- **Workstation**: measured Work / Config / Storage tabs, employee list with Pay and highlight,
  slot card, bind, recall/resume and a header chip with the player balance.
- **Embedded work-area map**: terrain, saved zones, other posts' zones, post limit, live selection,
  map layers and merged adjacent areas without internal border lines.
- **Storage rows**: swap the chest role directly from the row, plus detect, unlink and highlight.
- **Worker backpack**: measured board with the player grid, hotbar, 3x3 backpack and tool slot, and a
  Quill quantity overlay for stack transfers.
- **Admin**: six measured tabs (Salary, Billing, Schedule, Area/Housing, Market, System).
- **Quill UI 0.3.0-alpha.4**: `QuillChip`, header accessories, button icons and merged map zones.

## Changed

- Every screen uses `QuillScreen`, `setContent`, `QuillNodes` and `QuillListView`.
- Panels shrink to the window and content scrolls instead of clipping.

## Removed

- Legacy `LaborCraftAdminScreen`, `LaborCraftStationScreen` and `LaborCraftWorkerInventoryScreen`.
- Legacy `LcButton`, `LcScrollList`, `LcAreaMap` and `LcJobOption`.

## Fixed

- Tabs, cards and grids are no longer squeezed or cut in windows smaller than the old fixed panels.

## Notes

- Client-side, install **Quill UI 0.3.0-alpha.4** and **Quill UI Extras 0.3.0-alpha.4** next to
  LaborCraft. Dedicated servers need neither jar.
- Alpha release: the API and the UI may still change before 1.0.

# LaborCraft 0.1.0-alpha.14

First external currency adapter and the shared Quill UI visual foundation. This release includes the
MineLab `plims` provider and the first reusable UI layer.

## MineLab currency

- Added `minelab:plims` as an isolated `CurrencyProvider`, without importing or modifying MineLab
  classes.
- Reads and writes the `plims` scoreboard objective.
- Resolves offline players through the profile cache.
- Adds configurable Ledger fallback through `compatibility.mineLabObjective`, `mineLabFormat` and
  `mineLabFallbackToLedger`.
- The provider is available in the Admin panel provider selector.

## UI foundation

- Extracted the shared visual layer to **Quill UI 0.2.0-alpha.2**.
- `LcTheme`, `LcRender`, `LcTooltips`, `LcButton` and `LcScrollList` now delegate to Quill UI.
- Added the first design-system base for the Admin screen, header, cards and tab strip.
- Added `docs/19-DESIGN-UI.md`.

## Notes

- Clients must install **Quill UI 0.2.0-alpha.2** alongside LaborCraft.
- Dedicated servers do not need Quill UI.
- Additive changes are welcome; release notes stay in English following the project format.

# LaborCraft 0.1.0-alpha.13

Next development release. It includes the admin panel expansion, payment/filter UI, speech bubbles, safer contracts, lighting validation and the first MineLab compatibility notes. Alpha.11 and alpha.12 were not published separately; this release includes them.

## Admin panel

- `/laborcraft ui` (gamemaster) now has **Salary**, **Billing**, **Schedule**, **Area/House**, **Market** and **System** tabs.
- Schedule: mode, start/end ticks, rain, off-duty billing and idle check.
- Area/House: shape, radii, house bonus, particle preview, house validation, distance/volume/interior/bed limits and recheck interval.
- Market: offers per rotation, days per rotation and base worker limit.
- New generic live-config command: `/laborcraft admin config <field> <value>`.
- The panel refreshes in the same tab after changes.

## Lighting

- `housing.requireLight` is **on by default**.
- House validation checks for light-emitting blocks inside the room (torch, lantern, glowstone, sea lantern, campfire, shroomlight, etc.).
- Houses without a light source fail with a clear reason; the toggle is in **Area/House** and can be changed with `admin config housing.require-light <true|false>`.

## Earlier alpha.11/12 work included

- **Pay** button on Post and Profile rows with debt; filters for debt/strike/paused; context-aware screen refresh.
- Speech bubbles above workers, 10-block range, fade/bob/smoothing, important notices persistent and occasional ambient thoughts.
- Bubbles through walls are hidden by default; admin can enable globally for all players.
- Worker chat is `[Worker] Name: message` with the name in rarity color.
- Orphan station bindings can be replaced; dismissal/removal clears the station binding.
- Safer dismissal: counts post-strike misses, warns first and returns the worker contract instead of deleting the worker.

## Compatibility

- MineLab compatibility is documented as **high priority** in `docs/17-COMPATIBILIDADE-MINELAB.md`.
- The planned integration uses the `plims` scoreboard objective through an isolated `CurrencyProvider`, without referencing or modifying MineLab internals.
- The adapter itself is not implemented yet.

# LaborCraft 0.1.0-alpha.10

First release with the salary/billing base and the initial admin panel. Alpha.9 was not published separately; its billing work is included here.

## Added

- Configurable salary table: daily base, billing period, minimum, rank/rarity multipliers, upkeep boosts and multiplier cap.
- Recurring per-worker billing with debt, grace, strike, mood penalty, owner notifications and optional off-duty pausing.
- **Pagar** button in the Employee overview: pays the debt, resumes the worker and refreshes the screen. Also available as `/laborcraft worker pay <worker>`.
- Initial server-authoritative admin panel at `/laborcraft ui` (gamemaster):
  - **Salary** tab: base, period, contract price, minimum, boost cap, toggles and rank/rarity multipliers.
  - **Billing** tab: enabled, check interval, grace, dismissal, mood penalty, debt, notifications and schedule.
  - **System** tab: reload, status, currency provider, item test, players and market refresh.
  - Actions: apply table to existing workers, force billing, refresh market.
  - Integer and decimal prompts; panel refreshes in the same tab after each command.
- Salary/price changes regenerate market offers automatically.
- `/laborcraft billing set|rank|rarity|apply-salary|force` commands for live configuration.

## Safer contract policy

- `dismiss-after` now counts missed payments **after the worker is already on strike**, not total misses.
- The owner receives a final warning before dismissal.
- Automatic dismissal returns the worker contract to the owner instead of deleting the worker; if the owner is offline, dismissal is postponed.
- `dismiss-after = 0` (default) disables automatic dismissal.

## Notes

- Billing currently processes loaded workers only.
- Existing workers keep their wage snapshot until `apply-salary`; new offers use the current table.
- The initial admin panel covers Salary/Billing/System; schedule/area/house market tabs are still planned.
